source.citation: Kakushadze, Z. (2016), 101 Formulaic Alphas, Appendix A.1-A.3
source.formula_text_normalization: Original formula tokens and punctuation preserved; whitespace collapsed to one ASCII space after PDF text extraction.

history_contract.H: prior grid bars; max complete dependency span, not native graph scheduling
history_contract.advN: explicit full-window daily dollar_volume mean: N-1 prior bars
history_contract.Where: max of condition and both branches; conservative full dependency span
history_contract.cross_sectional: zero extra temporal history, within historical formula-universe and ResearchSpec.groups
history_contract.PIT: all inputs as-of effective/available times; no backfill; classification level and taxonomy required

paper_signal_timing.basis: do not infer delay-0/1 from formula offsets; timing remains an explicit implementation/usage decision

derived_formula_inputs.name: returns
derived_formula_inputs.definition: change = close[t] - close[t-1]; returns = change / close[t-1], in canonical binary64 operation order and the same adjusted-price convention
derived_formula_inputs.pit_rule: both close values must be available by the current formula grid; never bind a future label

field_requirement_records.name: returns
field_requirement_records.derivation: close[t] / close[t-1] - 1 on the same adjusted-price convention
field_requirement_records.pit_rule: both current and preceding close values must be available by the current grid; do not bind a future label

field_requirement_records.name: close
field_requirement_records.pit_rule: bind the explicit feed line or full-index external table; value must be available by the closed-bar grid; no fill across missing bars

numeric_oracle.planned_check: Use the pinned formula ID/source and independently computed matrix as the per-row numeric oracle; compare shape, finite/missing mask, and float values with a predeclared tolerance. Compare history_h with this ledger H.
numeric_oracle.contract_tests: 10 PASS; source-only independent reference contracts, not per-formula production acceptance
